en.quote: I think I have already told you that I have never changed the Constitution. I have no such plans today [to change the Constitution].
en.head: Amendment reset the presidential term limits
en.body: On March 10, 2020, Putin backed an amendment in the State Duma that would allow him to run for office again, subject to a Constitutional Court ruling. The Duma approved it by 380 votes to 43. In the nationwide vote on July 1, 2020, 77.92% voted for the amendments, with turnout at 67.97%.

notes: “Reset” is the established shorthand for the amendment’s effect on prior presidential terms.
